name: Etta
title: Provisioner
examine: Fen-born, from the crofts on the First Road waist. Everything on her shelves walked here up the unlit road, and the prices say so. She apologizes for them before you ask.
lines: The prices are the road's fault. I only write them down.
Grain from the ford, salt from the coast, apples when the carts are brave.
Nobody leaves my counter hungry. Broke, sometimes. Hungry, no.
